content:
ada-partnerships: FYI vendor (Glen @ AtlasCloud) just flagged a manifest split. They can only allocate 60% of our reserved GPU racks this cycle due to upstream component shortage. Adding thread so we can prioritize which commitments to keep.

leo-logistics: Ugh. Which POs are impacted? Need PO list and which region (EU/US) gets the shortfall.

glen-supplier: Hi all, quick recap from Atlas SCM: containers for batch AC-9X were deconsolidated. Available for Redwood: PO-4421 (US) 6/10 racks, PO-4499 (EU) 8/10 racks. Rest moved to later sailing. Apologies.

zara-ops: Can we split the remaining 4 racks across both launches or do we prefer full commit to one pilot? Tradeoffs: cross-region latency, deploy sequencing.

mohit-sales: Customer commitments: Pilot A (US) requires 6 racks to meet SLA in week-of Oct 5. Pilot B (EU) can tolerate 4 racks initially, growth week-of Oct 19. If we must choose, keep Pilot A priority.

ada (typo?) Wait ensure participants...
